passive.name: Rage Gene
passive.brief: Gains Rage in combat. At max Rage, transforms into Mega Gnar (melee, tanky, CC).
passive.full: Gnar generates Rage when in combat or taking damage. At maximum Rage, Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds — gaining massive bonus HP, armor, MR, and AD but losing range and attack speed.

q.name: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss
q.brief: Mini: boomerang that returns. Mega: throw boulder that slows.
q.full: Mini Gnar: Throw a boomerang that deals physical damage, slows, and returns. Catching it reduces CD. Mega Gnar: Throw a boulder that deals physical damage, slows, and stops on first enemy hit.

w.name: Hyper / Wallop
w.brief: Mini: 3rd AA deals %max HP magic. Mega: AoE stun.
w.full: Mini Gnar: Every 3rd auto-attack on the same target deals bonus magic damage based on target's max HP. Mega Gnar: Slam the ground, stunning and damaging enemies in a line.

e.name: Hop / Crunch
e.brief: Mini: hop (bounce off enemies). Mega: AoE jump + slow.
e.full: Mini Gnar: Hop to target location. If Gnar lands on an enemy, bounce further and deal damage. Mega Gnar: Leap to target location dealing AoE damage and slowing enemies on landing.

r.name: GNAR!
r.brief: Mega only: throw all nearby enemies in target direction. Stun if they hit terrain.
r.full: Mega Gnar only: Throw all nearby enemies in target direction dealing massive physical damage. If thrown enemies hit terrain (walls), they are stunned for 1.5 seconds and take bonus damage. THE game-winning team fight ult.

w.name: Drunken Rage

e.name: Body Slam

r.full: Throw an explosive cask at target location dealing magic damage and knocking enemies away from the center. Can be used to isolate targets (knock enemy carry into your team) or disengage.

passive.name: New Destiny
passive.brief: Shotgun AAs (2 bullets). Reload after 2 shots. AAs cannot pass through units.

q.name: End of the Line

w.name: Smoke Screen
w.brief: AoE smoke zone. Enemies inside have reduced vision + are slowed.
w.full: Fire a smoke canister creating a zone. Enemies inside have their vision greatly reduced (can't see outside) and are slowed.

e.name: Quickdraw
e.brief: Dash + gain armor stack + reload 1 bullet.
e.full: Dash in target direction and reload 1 bullet. Gain a stack of True Grit (bonus armor) for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times.

r.name: Collateral Damage
r.brief: Fire massive shell. Deals damage in line. Explodes at end for cone AoE.
r.full: Fire an explosive shell in a line dealing massive physical damage. At the end of its range or on hitting an enemy champion, it explodes in a cone dealing physical damage. Knocks Graves back slightly.

passive.name: Thousand Cuts
passive.brief: AAs deal bonus %max HP magic damage. Heals based on damage dealt.
passive.full: Gwen's auto-attacks deal bonus magic damage based on a percentage of the target's max HP. Gwen heals for a portion of the bonus damage dealt.

q.name: Snip Snip!
q.brief: 2-6 snips in a cone. Center snips deal true damage.
q.full: Snip 2-6 times in a cone (more snips from AA stacks). Each snip deals magic damage. The center of each snip deals TRUE damage instead. More AAs before casting = more snips.

w.name: Hallowed Mist
w.brief: Create a zone. Gwen is untargetable from outside the zone.
w.full: Create a misty zone around Gwen. Gwen cannot be targeted or hit by enemies outside the zone. The zone follows Gwen once (she can reposition it). Lasts 4 seconds.

e.name: Skip 'n Slash
e.brief: Dash. Gain bonus AS + range + on-hit for 4s.
e.full: Dash in target direction. For 4 seconds, gain bonus attack speed, bonus range, and bonus on-hit magic damage.

r.name: Needlework
r.brief: 3-cast ult. Each fires needles. Each successive cast fires more needles.
r.full: Cast 1: Fire a needle dealing magic damage and applying slow. Cast 2 (recast): Fire 3 needles. Cast 3 (recast): Fire 5 needles. Must hit an enemy to unlock next cast.
